artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: William Holl I or William Holl II
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man, revealing the upper half of his body. He is seated, turned slightly to his right, with his face directed towards the viewer. The man has a distinct facial structure with a pointed beard and a mustache. His hair is medium-length and waves out from under a wide-brimmed black hat. He is wearing a dark, richly textured garment with intricate embroidery along the shoulders, and a large, pleated ruff surrounds his neck. The background of the image is plain. The portrait is accompanied by the name "Sir Francis Bacon" beneath the image, alongside a separate large signature, and it is presented within a neatly framed space on a paper-like surface.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.artist: William Holl I or William Holl II
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, Lord Bacon, within an oval frame. He is facing slightly to the right, wearing a hat, a thick mustache and beard, and an elaborate outfit typical of the 16th or early 17th century. Below the portrait is a block of text about Lord Bacon. The background is a plain, light-colored sheet of paper with age spots.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon When a Boy
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a young boy in profile view facing to the right. He has a rounded face, short haircut, and a smooth complexion. He is wearing a Renaissance-style garment with a high collar and elaborate details. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: William Holl I or William Holl II after Nicholas Hilliard
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait of a young man, showing the upper portion of his torso and head. He is positioned facing slightly to the left while looking towards the viewer. The young man's facial features include defined eyebrows, a straight gaze, and a closed mouth. His hair is short and curly, styled close to the head but with volume at the top. He is wearing a high-collared, buttoned garment with a distinguished, elaborate ruff collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with a subtle circular shading around the figure. Beneath the portrait, there is text indicating the identity of the person as "Francis Bacon aged 18," along with credits for the artist and engraver.

artworks.title: The Monument of Lord Bacon, Saint Michael's Church
artworks.description: The image shows the monument of Lord Bacon in St. Michael's Church, St. Albans. A seated figure in historical attire with a contemplative pose is depicted. The sculpture appears to be made of stone and is set within an arched niche above a pedestal with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a historical figure, showing the upper half of his body in a seated position. He has curly hair, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He wears a formal outfit with a large, black hat and an ornate doublet with a ruffled collar. The background is simple with an oval border, featuring the title "LORD BACON." The image has a vintage appearance consistent with older engravings.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: Charles Henry Jeens after Peter Oliver
artworks.description: The image shows a small oval portrait of a man, only revealing his head and upper torso. He is positioned slightly angled to his right, giving a partial side profile. His facial features include a beard and a mustache, and his hair appears to be dark and is mostly covered by a hat. He is wearing a high-collared garment, along with an elaborate white ruff collar typical of the early 17th century fashion. The clothing appears richly detailed, suggesting formal attire. The man is not holding any objects, nor is any jewelry visible. Surrounding the portrait is a simple frame with the text "Anno Dni 1620" and "Aeatis Suae 60" indicating a date and the age of the subject. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a beige-colored paper. Below the portrait, there is text indicating the name "Francis Bacon" and credits for the engraving.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: Charles George Lewis after Joseph Murray Ince
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body in profile, facing left. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and curly, shoulder-length hair with balding on top. He wears a high collared garment with intricate detailing on the shoulder, reminiscent of Renaissance attire. The background is plain. Inscriptions at the bottom identify the artwork as "Bacon ex dono Daniells Lock in the Library of Trinity College."

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a man within an ornate decorative border. The man is in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly right with one hand on a table. He has a mustache and goatee, medium-length curled hair, and wears a detailed robe with a fur collar and patterns. He also wears a ruffled collar and holds gloves in his right hand, with a hat on the table next to him. The background has a simple wall pattern, and the portrait is enclosed within a highly detailed floral-patterned frame with swirling embellishments. The engraving appears aged.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon's Essays - Title Page
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from about the knees up. He is depicted standing with his body slightly turned to one side, one arm resting on a ledge, and the other hand holding a hat. The man has a well-defined mustache and goatee, with medium-length hair styled away from his face. He is wearing elaborate historical fashion, including a richly decorated garment, fur-trimmed cloak, and an ornate ruff around his neck. The image features detailed engravings of architectural elements in the background, possibly representing an interior space. The portrait is enclosed in a decorative frame within the print itself. The background is plain, with the title "LORD BACON'S ESSAYS" above the portrait and publication details at the bottom. The print shows signs of aging or staining.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a man with curly hair wearing a wide-brimmed hat. He is seen from the chest up, slightly turned towards the left and looking out at us. He has pale skin, a mustache, a neatly trimmed beard, arched eyebrows, and a long nose. He is dressed in an outfit with a high, stiff collar. The portrait is encased within an oval frame adorned with leaves, with the text "Sr. FRANCIS BACON" at the bottom. There is a dot of brown discoloration on the print.

artworks.title: Francois Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is turned slightly to the side, with a three-quarter view of his face. The man has a mustache, pointed beard, and wavy hair mostly covered by a tall, wide-brimmed black hat. He wears a large, intricate ruffle around his neck and a high-collared, patterned dark garment. The background includes text in French, a timeline, and descriptions related to historical and biographical details about the figure depicted.

artworks.title: Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's chest-up portrait. The man faces forward with a slight side gaze, featuring distinct facial features such as a mustache and small beard. He has curly hair below his ears and wears a broad-brimmed hat. He is dressed in an intricate garment with embroidery and a large ruffled collar around his neck. The portrait is within a decorated frame with classical motifs and symbols. The name "Bacon" is inscribed below the portrait. The background is plain with a few speckles, and there are publication details at the bottom.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man, identified as Lord Bacon. He is positioned facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a prominent mustache and a short, full beard. His hair is wavy, extending to his ears, and he is wearing a large, dark hat. He is dressed in a dark, elaborately designed garment with puffed sleeves and has a wide ruffled collar made of lace encircling his neck. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view, turned slightly to his right and looking directly at the viewer. He has a full mustache, a beard framing his chin, curly shoulder-length hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat, and wears ornate clothing typical of the early modern period, including a high ruff around his neck. The background is plain, with no visible jewelry or objects in his hands, conveying a formal setting.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The artwork presents a vignette portrait of Sir Francis Bacon from the upper torso upwards. He is positioned slightly turned to his right, in a partial three-quarter view. Sir Francis Bacon has a well-groomed beard and mustache, visible hair under a tall black hat, and wears a formal outfit typical of the early 17th century. He is adorned with a high lace ruff around his neck and an intricately patterned robe or jacket with visible sleeves. The background is plain, focusing attention on the figure. The image is centered on the paper with space around it, and the name "SIR FRANCIS BACON" is printed beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Baron Verulam
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He faces slightly to the right and looks directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a short beard with a mustache, and curly hair of medium length at the back and slightly receding at the temples. He wears elaborate attire typical of the Renaissance period, with a dark garment featuring intricate patterns on the sleeves and a high, stiff white collar. The engraving is encased in an oval border with an inscription below identifying him as "Francis Bacon, Baron Verulam &c." The background surrounding the oval is plain, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam
artworks.description: In the image, a man is seated in a chair. He is relaxed with his legs crossed, one arm on the armrest, and the other supporting his head by the chin. The man has a beard, a mustache, curly hair, and wears a large-brimmed hat. He is dressed in elaborate Renaissance attire, including a patterned jacket, a ruffled collar, knee-length shorts, stockings, and bow shoes. The chair is high-backed with round finials. The background is plain. The caption reads "Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam."

artworks.title: Francis, Lord Bacon
artworks.artist: Edward Scriven after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of Francis Lord Bacon. He is standing with his body turned slightly to the side and his head facing the viewer. He has a calm expression, a lightly bearded chin, and shoulder-length curly hair. He is wearing ornate clothing typical of the early 17th century, including a large ruff around his neck. He is holding a rolled object, and his left hand is resting on a document on a table with a hat beside it. The background features a curtain, an archway, and trees in the distance. The portrait is labeled "FRANCIS LORD BACON" below the image.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount Saint Alban
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man identified as Francis Bacon, Viscount St Alban. He is positioned to the side, with his gaze directed slightly away from the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, wavy shoulder-length hair, and wears a tall, rounded hat. He is dressed in formal attire typical of the period, including an ornate lace ruff collar and a fur-trimmed cloak with intricate patterns and plush textures. The background is plain, with a decorative line border framing the image. Below the portrait, there is text indicating his name, title, and year of death.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. The man has a prominent nose, short full beard, and a mustache. His hair is medium length and wavy, underneath a broad-brimmed hat. He wears a high ruff around his neck and a dark, textured garment with patterned designs on the shoulders and sleeves. The background is plain. There is an inscription below identifying the subject as Francis Bacon, Baron Verulam, Viscount St. Albans, with details about the engraving. The paper edges show signs of wear and discoloration.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait, from the chest upwards. He has a mustache, a short beard, prominent eyebrows, and curly hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. The man is seated facing forward but slightly turned to his right. He wears a dark robe with intricate sleeves, a white lace collar around his neck, and the background features a textured gradient.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is a full-length portrait of Sir Francis Bacon. He is depicted standing with one hand on a draped table and the other hand on his hip. He has distinct facial features, including prominent eyebrows, a mustache, and a small pointed beard. Bacon wears a high-crowned hat, with curly medium-length hair peeking out from under it. His attire includes a ruffled collar, a patterned doublet with ornate buttons, voluminous breeches, and a long cloak. A book with a coat of arms cover is on the table. The background features diagonal shading.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount Saint Albans
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man standing in a formal pose. He has a thick mustache and a full beard, wearing a detailed robe with a high collar. The man is holding a rolled paper in his right hand, with a hat placed on a table to his right. A draped curtain serves as the backdrop.
